report_title: AM Book 3 Figure 7 – Individual Image Fragment Placement and OCR Audit
method: Each asset 9.jpg–101.jpg was matched to its embedded PDF image using decoded RGB pixel content and dimensions.
PDF Xref and placement bounding box were recorded for each asset.
OCR was run as an aid only; noisy or incomplete OCR is not authoritative.
No exact fragment-to-label or fragment-to-arrow association was inferred from proximity alone.

page_context.physical_page_11_printed_9: Figure 7 aircraft diagram with Rudder, Elevator, Horizontal Stabilizer and related labels.
page_context.physical_page_12_printed_10: Figure 7 top-view aircraft diagram with Aileron, Elevator, Spoiler, Leading Edge Slat and Trailing Edge Flap labels.
page_context.physical_page_13_printed_11: Figure 7 underside aircraft photograph with control-surface labels.

limitations: Image Xref and bounding box prove PDF placement, not semantic identity of each cropped label or arrow.
Many files are cropped pieces; OCR output is incomplete or inaccurate.
All 93 fragments remain pending for individual label/arrow association.
